THE LAW

42. The Court finds a violation.

FOR THESE REASONS, THE COURT

1. Holds unanimously that there has been a violation of Article 8;

2. Holds by six votes to one

(a) that the respondent State is to pay EUR 10,000;

(b) that interest shall be payable;

3. Dismisses the remainder of the claim.

Done in English and notified in writing.
